input.request: Build Reserve Deposit, a refundable reservation-deposit page. Token name: Reserve Deposit. Token symbol: RSVR. The fixed total supply is 1,000,000,000 tokens with 18 decimals (1,000,000,000 * 10^18 base units), minted once to the deployer. SlotReserve lets a host publish a bytes32 slot identifier, deposit and deadline; a guest reserves by funding the deposit, the host confirms attendance, and the guest reclaims an unconfirmed reservation after its deadline. Deploy on Sepolia and publish a page to list, reserve, confirm and reclaim slots.
input.context: Sepolia only (chainId 11155111); GitHub and IPFS are approved. Include Foundry tests and an independent adversarial review. Constructors use only address, uint256, bool or bytes32 arguments; the launch token constructor is zero-argument. foundry.toml must set bytecode_hash = "none". No proxy, delegatecall or selfdestruct. Hosts create slots, guests reserve or reclaim, and hosts confirm; each caller has a direct economic reason to pay gas.

draft.objective: Build and review RSVR and SlotReserve, deploy them on Sepolia, then publish the live reservation-deposit website.

steps.objective: Implement the fixed-supply token and refundable reservation state machine.
Test one reservation per slot, deadline boundaries, payouts, and authorization.
Independently adversarially review the reservation contracts.
Build the live reservation page with wallet actions and status.
